Definition: from G3348; participant, i.e. (as noun) a sharer; by implication, an associate:--fellow, partaker, partner.
BiblicalUsage: Hebrews calls believers partakers of the heavenly calling and partakers of Christ, and partakers of the Holy Ghost, while Luke calls the partners in the other ship at the miraculous catch. The word is the sharer, the one who has a part in something, and Hebrews makes it the highest honour a believer can hold.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that partaking is the heart of the gospel: we are not spectators of Christ, we are partakers of Him, and if we hold our confidence steadfast to the end, the part we hold is real. If we hold our confidence steadfast to the end, the part we hold is real.
